title: 固定局部群体中已强成员首次两日反超与原领涨股失强
designExposure: Fifteen prior fixed candidate studies and two supplemental replications have been inspected. The local succession outline predates follower outcomes; these exact semantics are specified after those outcomes. This is adaptive development, not independent validation. No new local succession population or outcomes have been inspected to choose these rules.

sample.meaning: The unchanged original local-file sample is incomplete as a historical whole-market universe. All sample rows are retained regardless of eligibility or future results. The separately recovered 56 stocks are not appended.

sourceBinding.evidenceScope: Inherit the hash-bound independent parent-feature, raw-source, grouping and original-Top5 proof. Independently reconstruct new temporal state, ownership, selection and event arithmetic; do not claim inherited calculations were rerun.
sourceBinding.prohibitedInputs: Prior expansion/follower status, fills, returns, waiting and winners must not select or rank formations or succession opportunities. Other old files are bound only for integrity.
sourceBinding.streamClosure: All484 ordered days and3141 sorted unique predicate symbols per day, one selection day and exact original-Top5 group records, all identities/ranks/dates/hash/F=A-10, and EOF. Structural contradictions are fatal.

eligibleParentQ.true: kind signaled or notTriggered; all five passed values exact bool and all true.
eligibleParentQ.false: kind signaled or notTriggered; all five passed values exact bool and at least one false.
eligibleParentQ.unknown: All other kinds or incomplete predicate evidence. Ineligible is not a known false.
eligibleParentQ.breakout: Inherited same-day kind signaled, the unchanged close strictly above prior five raw daily highs.

relativeStrength.known: Each original predicate is an object with value finite int/float excluding bool in[0,1], passed exact bool (true OR false), reason key present and null. Numeric value alone is insufficient. Both fields must be known.
relativeStrength.independentOfQ: Anchor numeric ranks may be known even when its overall Q is unknown. Preserve both states; never infer Q from rank values or substitute features/score.
relativeStrength.comparison: Exact numeric lexicographic pair in field order, without rounding. Greater means member leads; equal is not leading. Symbol is never a strength tie-break.
relativeStrength.initial: Member must be Qtrue and strictly below the same anchor at A. All other initial states retained.

formation.opportunities: All original peer14 Top5 opportunities regardless of expansion/follower performance; source contains148.
formation.A: Source slot.date when the original Top5 becomes known; earlier F is only provenance.
formation.members: Exactly the frozen twenty members and existing F correlation order. F=A-10 on the full source calendar including warmup; no recomputation/replacement.
formation.oneEpisodePerAnchor: Earliest source opportunity owns fixed lock A..A+5 inclusive. Suppressed opportunities retained. Earliest next A+6 even if all members terminate earlier.
formation.initialTerminalMeaning: Priority applies in order: invalid group; member Qunknown; Qfalse; either needed pair unknown; member pair>=anchor pair; otherwise observe. Keep all initial evidence even when one reason wins.
formation.invalidGroup: Retain unevaluable formation and fixed lock; no manufactured members or next-day retry. Integrity contradictions fatal.
formation.ordering: Advance old episodes then activate new ones. Calendar positions determine offsets, never available bars. At A+5 evaluate the day before expiry.

memberState.continuousStrength: Only initially admitted members observe. Every day A+1..A+5 requires member Qtrue. First Qunknown or Qfalse terminates permanently.
memberState.dailyTerminalMeaning: Check member Qunknown, Qfalse, then either rank pair unknown, then first leading run of two. Record all evidence and reason flags, including simultaneous missing ranks. No recovery or skipping.
memberState.leading: With member Qtrue and both ranks known, greater increments consecutive count, less/equal resets to0. Required unknown rank ends the episode, including unknown anchor rank.
memberState.firstPair: First two consecutive leading closes consumes episode. Earliest A+2. On second close emit raw confirmation only if inherited breakout; otherwise terminal confirmedWithoutBreakout. Never wait for later pair/breakout.
memberState.triggerConsumed: First pair consumed regardless of mask, duplicate ownership, Top5, active positions or execution.
memberState.expiry: After offset5 assessment, observing members expire. Study cutoff before offset5 censors still-observing members; not failure.
memberState.futureMutation: Later information cannot change prior membership, transitions, ownership or emitted signals.

anchorPairGate.evaluation: Apply only to raw confirmations after ownership/globalTop5, using anchor Q on the first leading pair two closes.
anchorPairGate.unknown: Either Q value unknown, even if the other is known true; preserve observed failure evidence separately. Unknown is never admitted.
anchorPairGate.false: Both Q known and at least one true.
anchorPairGate.noPermanentCancellation: Anchor earlier Qfalse/unknown has no persistent gate effect when its required numeric ranks remain known. Pair Q state is not inferred from rank evidence.

selection.ownership: First source per member under rawOrder from ALL raw confirmations. Keep duplicates, never prefer a passing anchor mask or available position.
selection.top5: Globally first5 unique owned members BEFORE pair gate and active exclusions; no replacement/backfill.
selection.candidate: Admit original Top5 slots only for anchorPairGate true.
selection.memberBaseline: Admit all original Top5 members, without anchorPairGate.
selection.anchorControl: Map candidate-admitted original slots to their anchor at the same close; first slot per anchor retained, collisions logged; no backfill.
selection.active: Three independent active-symbol states. Unchanged T+1 event engine, one next-opening attempt,100000 per event, frozen legacy fees/slippage, no stop or holding deadline. Formation/selection never reads active positions.
selection.controlInterpretation: Descriptive gate increment and trading-object comparison, not randomized causality or matched actual fills. Shared members/dates and separate active states induce dependence.

requiredEvidence: All opportunities, locks, initial evidence and excluded members
Daily Q and numeric rank evidence, leading streak and first terminal including simultaneous unknown reasons
First-pair evidence, raw ownership, global Top5, all three dispositions and anchor collisions
Seven5/10/20/40/60/120/250-session cohorts, time distributions, raw adverse paths and concentration
Bound hashes, strict single-attempt lifecycle, independent reconstruction and arithmetic review

executionPolicy.legacyFeeProfile: Unchanged previous static fee config for diagnostic comparability. Isolated dated fee helper not integrated.

limitations: Crossing may occur entirely because the old anchor weakens; it does not demonstrate member acceleration or actual market leadership succession.
Threshold jitter, shared factors and raw-price corporate actions may mimic the mechanism.
Reused development data, fixed surviving universe and missing historical identity/rights/full fees/opening-auction evidence prevent probability certification.
No actual market-leader status, causal influence, operator control or high future net30 probability is assumed.
